note: Wadena County park on the Crow Wing River canoe trail near Staples, popular for swimming, picnics and as a tube and canoe landing. Some sites are set up for horse campers; a 2.5-mile trail to Bullard's Bluff Park is open to horses and ATVs. --Claude
summary: County pages read: 17 primitive sites (no hookups), $17 (fee schedule effective 2025-10-07), first come (only Old Wadena takes reservations), outhouses and hand pumps. Stored phone-reservation claim was wrong. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Booking corrected: stored reservable true / platform phone (derived from note prose) replaced by first come; the county says 'All but 1 campground are "first come, first serve"' and the one reservable campground is Old Wadena.

OHV/HORSE (flag only): 'A through trail from Cottingham Park to Bullard's Bluff Park provides approximately 2.5 miles of nature walking, horseback riding, ATV riding, and hiking. Cottingham is also unique in that it has campsites available for accommodating horse enthusiasts.' A general county campground with a short multi-use trail, not a staging or trail-system camp; keep.

Local operator: Wadena County Parks (Parks Administrator, 218-631-7604, confirmed; Google lists the same). Google Maps 4.6 stars / 70 reviews. Real public campground, not a seasonal-lease park. Season not stated; payment method not stated.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: on leaf-off imagery the Crow Wing River here is about 50 m wide; the open ground at the pin (46.505476,-94.807675) is the canoe/tube landing about 25-40 m from the bank, and the camp loops run south into the pines. No source places or numbers the 17 sites, so no site can be named; defaults down.
